body_markdown:
Convenient Public Storage options in Chicago include 362 W Chicago Ave in the Near North Side, 947 W Van Buren St in the West Loop, 1916 N Elston Ave near Bucktown and 1711 W Fullerton Ave near Lincoln Park. These locations connect with major routes such as I-90/I-94, I-290 and Lake Shore Drive.


The most convenient choice depends on your neighborhood, daily route and how you plan to transport your belongings. Compare each location’s access hours, unit sizes and features before reserving.


## What Public Storage Options Are Available in Chicago?


Public Storage has 110 facilities in Chicago and nearby communities. Climate-controlled storage is available at 56 facilities, while 78 offer car storage. Available spaces range from lockers to 10×30 units.


Common unit sizes are widely available throughout the area:


Unit size Chicago-area facilities offering the size


5×5 87

Monthly prices start at $24, and the average monthly unit price is $132. Prices, promotions, features and availability vary by location and can change.


## Convenient Self-Storage in Chicago: 362 W Chicago Ave


Public Storage at[362 W Chicago Ave](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago/1268.html) is in the Near North Side between Orleans Avenue and Sedgwick Street. The facility is accessible from LaSalle Drive, Michigan Avenue and I-90/I-94.


The property offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Standard access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** The West Chicago Avenue location can work well for customers in River North, the Gold Coast and nearby central neighborhoods. Its proximity to I-90/I-94 also provides a direct route for customers arriving from other parts of the city.


## Where Else Can You Find Convenient Self-Storage in Chicago?


Chicago traffic, expressways and neighborhood street patterns can make a familiar route more useful than the shortest distance on a map.


### West Loop Near I-290


Public Storage at[947 W Van Buren St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago/1739.html) is in the West Loop near Racine Avenue, the Eisenhower Expressway and the University of Illinois Chicago area.


The facility offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Standard access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may suit customers in the West Loop, Greektown and nearby areas or those who regularly travel on I-290 or streets leading into downtown.


### Elston Avenue Near Bucktown


Public Storage at[1916 N Elston Ave](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago/1308.html) is near Bucktown and the North Branch of the Chicago River, with access from Elston Avenue, North Avenue and I-90/I-94.


The facility offers car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Standard access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Elston Avenue location can be practical for customers in Bucktown, Wicker Park and nearby Northwest Side neighborhoods or anyone who regularly uses the Kennedy Expressway.


### Fullerton Avenue Near Lincoln Park


Public Storage at[1711 W Fullerton Ave](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago/1740.html) is near Lincoln Park, Lakeview and the Kennedy Expressway.


The facility offers climate-controlled storage, car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Standard access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may fit customers on the North Side who regularly travel along Fullerton Avenue or use I-90/I-94 to reach other parts of Chicago.


## What Makes a Self-Storage Facility Convenient in Chicago?


In Chicago, convenience often depends on staying close to your neighborhood or avoiding an unnecessary expressway trip.


When comparing Chicago storage facilities, consider:


- **Your usual route:** Look near I-90/I-94, I-290, Lake Shore Drive or another road you already use.
- **Neighborhood:** A facility near home, work or a regular destination can make storage visits easier to include in your day.
- **Access hours:** All four featured locations currently list standard access from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.
- [Climate-controlled storage in Chicago](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago/climate-controlled-storage-units) **:** Chicago’s seasonal temperature and humidity changes can affect belongings that react to changing conditions. These units are designed to help maintain more consistent temperature and humidity levels than non-climate-controlled storage.
- **Indoor or outdoor access:** Indoor units may involve hallway or elevator access. Some outdoor units offer Drive-Up Access, but confirm the feature for the exact unit.
- [Vehicle storage in Chicago](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago/car-storage-units) **:** Car, boat, RV and motorcycle storage is available at select Chicago-area facilities.
- **Loading and parking:** Review where you can park or unload and the route from the entrance to the unit.


## Which Storage Unit Size Should You Choose?


The right size depends on what you plan to store and how often you expect to retrieve it.


- A **5×5 unit** can hold boxes, seasonal decorations and smaller household items.
- A **5×10 unit** can accommodate the contents of one room, including some furniture.
- A **10×10 unit** offers space for furnishings and boxes from several rooms.
- A **10×20 unit** can support a larger move or home project involving multiple rooms.


Actual dimensions and capacities vary. Use the[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) and review the specific unit before renting when possible.


## How Do You Choose the Most Convenient Storage Facility in Chicago?


Start with the neighborhood and expressway already in your routine. West Chicago Avenue may suit customers in the Near North Side, while Van Buren Street provides a West Loop option near I-290. Elston Avenue and Fullerton Avenue may be more practical for customers on the North and Northwest sides.


Then compare access hours, unit type, size and loading arrangements. If you need climate-controlled storage, Drive-Up Access, vehicle storage or 24/7 Access, confirm availability for the exact facility and unit before reserving.

Yes. Car storage is available at 78 area facilities, including the featured Elston Avenue and Fullerton Avenue locations. Space type, dimensions and availability vary.


### Do the featured Chicago facilities offer 24/7 Access?

### What are the standard access hours at the featured Chicago facilities?


All four currently list standard access from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily. Hours can change, so review the individual property page before visiting.


### How much does a storage unit cost in Chicago?


Monthly prices start at $24, and the average monthly unit price is $132. Your price will depend on the location, size, features, promotion and current availability.


### How can I find a Public Storage facility near me in Chicago?


Search by your address, neighborhood or ZIP code on the[Chicago Public Storage page](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-il-chicago) . Compare the route, access hours, loading arrangements and unit features for each location.


## Find Convenient Self-Storage in Chicago


Public Storage offers options in the Near North Side, West Loop, Bucktown, Lincoln Park and throughout the Chicago area. Choose a facility that fits your neighborhood and regular route, then confirm the unit size, access hours and features before reserving.
